title: Working at Tessl - Sahil's Story
description:
What if plain text could change the future of programming? Sahil thinks it can. 💡

Sahil was hooked on Tessl from the moment he heard the philosophy: that document specifications and plain text context are going to drive the next era of software development. In this video, he shares what it's actually like to work there — the culture, the autonomy, and why he'd happily still be here in five years.

If you want to know what it looks like when a high-calibre engineering team pairs deep experience with a genuine openness to doing things differently, this one's for you.

What Sahil talks about:

- The big idea that first drew him to Tessl
- Why the team's experience combined with their willingness to experiment is such a rare thing
- What high trust and high autonomy actually look like day to day
- How people at Tessl are shipping things that weren't even on the roadmap — just from following their instincts
- Where he sees himself (and Tessl) in five years 🚀

The kind of place where you don't need to ask permission to go solve a problem you care about? Yeah, that exists.

Like and subscribe for more from the people building the future of software at Tessl!
